summary.text: Pseudo venerable names battle strength just short of a true rank nine venerable, a peak Fairy Zi Wei already uses when projecting Spectral Soul's completed plan.

claims.text: Fairy Zi Wei judges that if Spectral Soul had succeeded in his plan, great grandmaster attainment in all paths plus devouring apertures and Shadow Sect with Zombie Alliance resources could take him straight to rank eight, and at that level Spectral Soul would have pseudo-venerable battle strength.

Red Lotus’ will tells Feng Jiu Ge that the rank eight future self killer move will allow him to instantly gain pseudo venerable battle strength, because he is the Dao Guardian of the predestined Great Dream Immortal Venerable. In history, as long as Dao Guardians matured, they would have such a cultivation level.

After the fate war, everyone in the world has seen Fang Yuan’s performance. The world knows about his pseudo venerable battle strength, and the title of the number one demon in the world belongs to him with nobody daring to contest it.

Qin Ding Ling states that with Duke Long dead and Feng Jiu Ge having betrayed them, Heavenly Court desperately needs a pseudo venerable capable of holding the situation. Heavenly Court needs someone with that battle strength to support them.
Demon Immortal Qi Jue subdues Di Zang Sheng in one move and is named as holding true pseudo venerable battle strength.

With his own strength alone, Fang Yuan disrupts the whole Eastern Sea alliance army; observers call that pseudo venerable battle strength and the strength of the number one demon of the present age. Others on the field look for another fighter with the same battle strength as the only match for him. The aftermath of two pseudo venerables fighting is named as terrifying enough to shatter the heavenly wind qi wall.

Lu Wei Yin tells Fang Yuan that the difference between venerable and pseudo venerable lies in the concept of Dao Lord. A Dao Lord is the lord of a certain path: when a Gu Immortal becomes venerable with supreme grandmaster attainment level, that person becomes the leader of that path, and improvement of the person signifies improvement of the path and of heaven and earth. As a Dao Lord, the Gu Venerable can sense all of the natural dao marks of heaven and earth of that path and refine them, then manipulate them at will. That same concept is why venerable methods can remain for years without dissipating.

Battle strength at this height need not be even across offense and defense. Lu Wei Yin lacks offense in one clash, yet his defense is firmly in the realm of pseudo venerable level, while a strong killer that can kill many rank eights is still judged short of that level. Speakers still draw a hard line: however strong Fang Yuan is, he is still just a pseudo venerable, not a true venerable.

Lu Wei Yin, with pseudo venerable battle strength, is clear that fighting a venerable head-on is courting death, yet in certain situations pseudo venerables can still influence the victory and defeat of venerables. When Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable deadlock, they invite Fang Yuan and other pseudo venerables as the crucial pieces needed to tilt victory. After Demon Immortal Qi Jue’s death in Crazed Demon Cave, only three experts with that battle strength remain in the world in that accounting.
Dao Lord covers the path-lord concept that separates this battle strength from a true venerable. Dao Guardian covers the matured guardians who historically reach the same height.
